summary: Liquidity Services Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a fourth amendment to its existing credit agreement with Wells Fargo Bank. The amendment extends the maturity date from March 31, 2027 to March 31, 2028, with all other terms remaining unchanged. The $35 million line of credit continues for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt modification, not a change-of-control event nor a special situation. No other material agreements, tender offers, or strategic actions are referenced. Watch for future refinancing or covenant revisions, but no risk-arb angle exists here.
